prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
UKIP Manifesto 2010 – Summary (ideological framing retained)

Core purpose
- Leave the EU to restore national self-government, end rule by unelected EU bodies, and reclaim three freedoms: action (make our own laws and deals), resources (stop vast EU costs and red tape), and people (return power to Westminster and voters via binding referenda).

Economy and tax
- Simpler, lower taxes to revive enterprise: raise tax-free threshold to £11,500; introduce a single 31% flat tax (merging income tax and employee NI); phase out Employers’ NI over five years; scrap Inheritance Tax when viable.
- Replace VAT with a Local Sales Tax, boost local funding from UBR, cut council tax by axing costly EU rules, cull quangos, and shrink the public sector to its 1997 size while protecting frontline services.
- Repeal damaging EU directives; return financial regulation to the UK; split retail and investment banking (Glass–Steagall style); raise capital ratios.

Jobs, industry, skills
- Rebuild manufacturing and eliminate the trade deficit via five long-term programmes: defence kit expansion; nuclear new-build to 50% of electricity; flood/coastal defences; transport upgrades (rail, roads, ports/airports); modern prison construction. Create c. 1 million skilled jobs.
- Production Enterprise Centres to help SMEs innovate and export; defend strategic UK firms; scrap costly green taxes/trading schemes.
- Denationalise HE/FE funding with Student/Training Vouchers.

Immigration and asylum
- End mass immigration: five-year freeze on permanent settlement; thereafter a tightly capped, points-based system (≤50,000 p.a.).
- Leave the EU to control borders; time-limited work permits/visas; overstaying criminalised; triple border staff; no amnesties; deport illegal residents; restore the Primary Purpose Rule.
- Repeal the Human Rights Act and leave the ECHR system.

Law and order
- Victims first; zero tolerance. Elected County Police Boards; “life means life”; double prison places; end early release; three-strikes; stronger self-defence rights; boot camps for youth offenders; withdraw from the European Arrest Warrant; abolish the CPS.

Defence
- Increase spending by ~40% (+1% of GDP); expand Army to 125,000; restore Navy (3 carriers, ~70 ships); strengthen RAF (helicopters, transport, JSF); keep and renew independent Trident; NATO focus; cut MoD bureaucracy; reappraise Afghanistan.

NHS and welfare
- No frontline cuts; elected County Health Boards; slash bureaucracy; franchise services for efficiency; Health Credit Vouchers to enable private opt-out; restore matrons, eye tests, dental checks.
- Replace 70+ benefits with a Basic Cash Benefit; merge child/nursery supports; limit benefits to citizens/residents (≥5 years); Workfare for recipients.

Education
- School Vouchers; retain/expand grammar and “professional” schools; rigorous basics and discipline; more on-the-job teacher training; end 50% uni target; Student Vouchers/grants; elected Education Boards; franchise providers; scrap Ofsted.

Energy and environment
- Climate realism: repeal the Climate Change Act; prioritise affordable, reliable power—50% nuclear; domestic coal; stop wind subsidies (offshore only if viable); exit EU carbon schemes; Royal Commission to review evidence; invest in flood defences and electrified transport.

Transport
- +£3bn p.a. infrastructure; better roads; fuel duty “windfall return”; Britdisc for foreign lorries; oppose mega-EU lorries; three high-speed rail lines; reopen lines; Thames Estuary hub airport over Heathrow expansion.

Housing and planning
- Cut demand by controlling immigration; local referenda on major schemes; scrap regional quangos/IPC/HIPs; protect Green Belt via elected conservators; boost social housing.

Constitution and culture
- Direct democracy (5% trigger for binding referenda); AV+; elected Police/Health/Education Boards/Mayors; recall MPs; abolish regional government; support the monarchy/Church; English-only sitting days.
- Civic, inclusive nationalism; oppose multiculturalism; protect British brands, measures, Royal Mail/Post Offices; teach British achievements; ban burqa/niqab in public buildings; deport extremist preachers; modern Treason Act; new Commonwealth Day and St George’s Day.

Farming and fishing
- Leave CAP/CFP; keep farm support during transition; pro-labeling (including GM) and animal welfare; supermarket ombudsman.
- Reclaim a 200nm EEZ; end quotas and discards; ban industrial trawling; strengthen protection.

Other
- Back pubs with designated smoking rooms; champion SMEs; strong animal welfare.
